name: Bahrain (1932–1972)
description: A red field with a white vertical stripe at the hoist, the two separated by a serrated line of twenty-eight white points.
history: In 1932 a serrated edge was added to the white hoist stripe of Bahrain's red flag to distinguish it from the flags of its neighbours; this version had twenty-eight points. The number was reduced to eight in 1972.
